feed.title: Koorosh Azizi Research News
feed.subtitle: Publications, projects and milestones from the Urban Hydrosystems & Resilience Lab.

entry.title: Paper accepted in Nature Cities
entry.summary: Coupled human-environmental systems: socio-behavioral and spatial dynamics in green stormwater infrastructure adoption was accepted in August 2026.

entry.title: New project on roadway flooding and emergency access in Nashville
entry.summary: A CHDT University Transportation Center award supports coupled flood-hazard, road-network and traveler-response research in Nashville.

entry.title: Flood-governance networks paper published in Water Resources Research
entry.summary: New network-analytic work identifies gaps and opportunities for collaborative flood governance on the U.S. Gulf Coast.

entry.title: Flood exposure and household green stormwater infrastructure adoption published
entry.summary: The study tests whether household green stormwater infrastructure adoption aligns with flood exposure and parcel feasibility.

entry.title: The Urban Hydrosystems & Resilience Lab opens at Tennessee State University
entry.summary: Koorosh Azizi joined Tennessee State University and founded the Urban Hydrosystems & Resilience Lab.

entry.title: Presented agent-based green-infrastructure research at AGU25
entry.summary: Research on socio-behavioral dynamics of household green stormwater infrastructure adoption was presented at AGU25.

entry.title: Departmental seminar at Tennessee State University
entry.summary: Invited departmental seminar at Tennessee State University on coupled human-infrastructure dynamics.

entry.title: Miami-Dade water-management paper published
entry.summary: The paper examines effectiveness and equity in sustainable water-management transitions.
